convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for UltraFatl indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for trading logic and smoothing algorithms. Multi-timeframe logic with custom indicator buffer interpretation.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator calculation
derived_values.formula: 40 + GetStartBars(W_Method, StartLength+nStep*nStepsTotal, WPhase) + 1 + GetStartBars(SmoothMethod, SmoothLength, SmoothPhase) + 3 + SignalBar

other_exits: Signal-based close: long closes when sell signal appears (Value[1]<5 && Value[1]), short closes when buy signal appears (Value[1]>4)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative value = fixed lot size (abs value), positive value = share of deposit in a deal

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic uses UltraFatl indicator buffer 2 values as discrete signal levels. Buy signal: previous bar value > 4 AND current bar value < 5 and non-zero. Sell signal: previous bar value < 5 and non-zero AND current bar value > 4. This suggests buffer 2 contains a trend direction code (e.g., values around 4-5 represent buy/sell zones). Signal is evaluated at SignalBar offset (default=1), meaning it reads from completed bars. The boolean inputs BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose act as trade permission gates.
python_conversion_notes: The UltraFatl custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python since it relies on SmoothAlgorithms.mqh which contains JJMA and other proprietary smoothing methods (JMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA). The indicator's multi-step variable-period smoothing is non-trivial. The signal interpretation uses discrete levels from buffer 2 (values around 4-5 as buy/sell thresholds), which must be reverse-engineered from the custom indicator source. TradeAlgorithms.mqh must also be ported - it handles BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose with position gating, lot sizing, and order execution. The conditional MM parameter (negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction) needs careful handling. SL/TP of 1000/2000 points likely need 5-digit adjustment (multiply by 10 if _Point==0.00001).
